_comment: Canonical Go per-package mutation efficacy floors (percent). Single source of truth. Read directly by .github/scripts/gen_report_portal.py; api/Makefile and .github/workflows/nightly-mutation.yml mirror these values and are drift-guarded against this file by gen_report_portal_test.py (a mismatch fails CI). Technique shards aggregate into the single 'techniques' scope. Note: transport/http was removed (ARCH-2); it is a dev-only harness (see api/internal/transport/http/doc.go) and is no longer held to a production mutation floor. dp and human floors raised to 100 (MUT-3, commit 7b739d1): the determinism fix eliminated the map-order flakiness that previously held these scopes at 95/98, verified by four consecutive nightly runs (2026-07-16 through 2026-07-19) all reporting 1.000000 efficacy. techniques floor set to 99.9 (revised down from 100 post-MUT-3, commit pending): residual test-side non-determinism in the curated-fixture solver path causes 1-2 mutants per nightly run to intermittently escape in random technique shards (observed: ur on 2026-07-20, als_chains on 2026-07-20 manual). 99.9 absorbs ~5 escapes out of ~5017 technique mutants while still catching real regressions (a 10-escape regression falls to 99.8% < 99.9% = FAIL). The hard-100 target remains; investigate the test-side root cause and tighten back to 100 once stable.
